features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, capturing relative magnitude between the two spatial coordinates. Values near 1 indicate symmetry; deviations indicate asymmetry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous ratio useful for linear SVM margins to distinguish spatial asymmetry patterns.

features.name: v1_v2_diff_normalized
features.description: Normalized absolute difference between V1 and V2, scaled by their sum. Measures relative divergence between the two coordinates.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized score in [0,1] capturing spatial divergence, well-suited for linear SVM decision boundaries.

features.name: v3_log_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed V3 value to reduce skewness and compress the range for better linear separability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation of V3 linearizes its distribution, improving linear SVM margin quality.

features.name: v1_mean_deviation
features.description: Standardized deviation of V1 from its training mean (509.97), scaled by training std (280.32).
features.expected_model_benefit: Zero-centered normalized feature directly usable as a linear projection component for SVM.

features.name: v2_mean_deviation
features.description: Standardized deviation of V2 from its training mean (510.44), scaled by training std (288.58).
features.expected_model_benefit: Zero-centered normalized feature directly usable as a linear projection component for SVM.

features.name: v3_mean_deviation
features.description: Standardized deviation of V3 from its training mean (0.4111), scaled by training std (0.0608).
features.expected_model_benefit: Zero-centered normalized V3 feature for linear SVM, capturing how far V3 deviates from typical values.

features.name: v1_v2_product_normalized
features.description: Product of normalized V1 and V2, capturing joint spatial magnitude interaction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bilinear interaction term approximating a kernel feature, useful for linear SVM to capture joint coordinate effects.

features.name: v3_v1_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized V3 and normalized V1, capturing how spatial intensity relates to coordinate position.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cross-feature interaction term that helps linear SVM capture non-linear relationships between V3 intensity and V1 position.

features.name: v3_v2_interaction
features.description: Interaction between normalized V3 and normalized V2, capturing how spatial intensity relates to the second coordinate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cross-feature interaction term that helps linear SVM capture non-linear relationships between V3 intensity and V2 position.

features.name: spatial_magnitude
features.description: Euclidean-like combined magnitude of V1 and V2, normalized by the maximum possible value (1008*sqrt(2)).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized composite score representing overall spatial magnitude, useful as a single linear feature for SVM.

features.name: v3_intensity_severity
features.description: Semantic severity score for V3 intensity level. V3 near 0 or near its max (0.789) may indicate extreme conditions; values near the mean (0.411) are moderate. Score reflects deviation from the central tendency on a 0-10 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Interpretable severity score that maps V3 to a human-meaningful scale, providing a smooth continuous input for linear SVM margins.

features.name: spatial_asymmetry_score
features.description: Semantic asymmetry score combining V1-V2 divergence and V3 intensity. High scores indicate strong spatial asymmetry with extreme V3 values, potentially indicating volcanic features. Scored 0-10.
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composite score capturing multi-feature asymmetry patterns, providing a smooth interpretable input for linear SVM decision boundaries.
